explication: Wifite is a command-line wireless-network auditing application that orchestrates existing wireless tools. Its main workflow initializes configuration and dependencies, scans and presents access points for selection, then dispatches selected targets to protocol-specific attacks that capture or crack credentials. Separate commands inspect or crack previously captured handshakes and display saved results. The README documents WPS, WPA handshake, PMKID, WEP, hidden-network decloaking, and capture validation. Some attack and orchestration source was not sampled, so those branches follow documented capabilities and visible module boundaries; only supported wiring is shown.
